title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named UCSC places for studying, gathering, making, and attending campus events.

cards.title: Start at Quarry Plaza
cards.subtitle: Campus hub beside the Student Union
cards.notes: Use the plaza as a meeting point, then check the student organizations and campus services gathered around its central walkways.
cards.short_summary: A central outdoor hub for campus services, organizations, and public activity.
cards.evidence_claim: UCSC identifies Quarry Plaza as the heart of campus and says it includes the Student Union, student organizations, a café, and the campus store.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor plaza; individual nearby services and events may have separate access rules.

cards.title: See what is on at the Quarry
cards.subtitle: Outdoor venue in Quarry Plaza
cards.notes: Look for a scheduled performance, rally, or campus gathering, and use the terraced seating when the venue is open for an event.
cards.short_summary: A 2,600-seat outdoor campus venue built into a former lime quarry.
cards.evidence_claim: UCSC describes the Quarry Amphitheater as a former lime quarry that now hosts convocations, rallies, and performances.
cards.access_notes: Event access depends on the program and venue policies.

cards.title: Settle into McHenry Library
cards.subtitle: Main campus library building
cards.notes: Choose McHenry for library research or a reserved study room; check the library’s live departmental-hours listing before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: The principal UCSC library building, with study rooms and specialized library spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: UCSC Library lists McHenry Library and links visitors to reserve study rooms and obtain maps and directions.
cards.access_notes: Hours and room availability vary; use the library’s current hours and reservation links.

cards.title: Work from Science & Engineering Library
cards.subtitle: Science Hill library
cards.notes: Reserve a study room for a focused work session, or use the building as a research stop while visiting Science Hill.
cards.short_summary: A UCSC library on Science Hill with reservable study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: UCSC Library lists the Science & Engineering Library and provides study-room reservation and directions links for it.
cards.access_notes: Hours and room availability vary; consult the library’s current listing.

cards.title: Use the Digital Scholarship Commons
cards.subtitle: Ground floor of McHenry Library
cards.notes: Bring a project that benefits from digital tools, then confirm current access and equipment-desk hours through the library before visiting.
cards.short_summary: A McHenry Library digital-work space with lab-space reservations and an equipment desk.
cards.evidence_claim: UCSC Library places the Digital Scholarship Commons on McHenry Library’s ground floor and offers DSC lab-space reservations.
cards.access_notes: Equipment desk and space hours are listed by the library and may differ from building hours.

cards.title: Check the Cultural Center at Merrill
cards.subtitle: Merrill Commons, Merrill College
cards.notes: Watch for a lecture, performance, reception, or campus gathering, and use the venue’s reservation page to understand event access.
cards.short_summary: A large flexible event center at Merrill College for lectures, performances, and gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: UCSC Spaces says the Cultural Center at Merrill hosts events ranging from lectures and receptions to theatrical performances and major campus gatherings.
cards.source_title: Cultural Center at Merrill – UCSC Spaces
cards.access_notes: Reservable venue; attendance and entry depend on the specific event.

cards.title: Pause at Merrill Plaza
cards.subtitle: Outdoor social center at Merrill College
cards.notes: Meet outdoors at the tables or picnic seating, while checking whether a reservation is in place before planning a larger gathering.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor plaza with seating beside the Cultural Center at Merrill.
cards.evidence_claim: UCSC Spaces describes Merrill Plaza as an outdoor social-center space with picnic tables and outdoor seating, open unless reserved.
cards.access_notes: Open unless reserved; usage is subject to campus policies and event reservations.

cards.title: Read or regroup in Baobab Lounge
cards.subtitle: Merrill College
cards.notes: Use the lounge for a quieter study break or informal gathering, taking advantage of its piano and television when appropriate.
cards.short_summary: A Merrill College lounge combining study space with informal gathering amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The UCSC catalog says Baobab Lounge provides study space and informal gathering space and includes a piano and television.
cards.source_title: Merrill College – UC Santa Cruz General Catalog
cards.access_notes: Located in Merrill College; observe college and building access policies.

cards.title: Print at Ming Ong Computer Center
cards.subtitle: Merrill College
cards.notes: Use the desktop computers or printing access for course work, then confirm current college access requirements before relying on the space.
cards.short_summary: A Merrill College computer center with desktop computers and printing.
cards.evidence_claim: The UCSC catalog states that the Ming Ong Computer Center provides access to desktop computers and printing.
cards.source_title: Merrill College – UC Santa Cruz General Catalog
cards.access_notes: Located in Merrill College; confirm current building access and printing availability.

cards.title: Find Page Smith Library at Cowell
cards.subtitle: Cowell College
cards.notes: Add this named college library to a Cowell walk, pairing it with nearby college spaces shown on the official self-guided tour.
cards.short_summary: A named library stop on Cowell College’s official self-guided tour.
cards.evidence_claim: Cowell College’s official maps and tours page includes Page Smith Library among its self-guided tour locations.
cards.access_notes: Located at Cowell College; verify current building access before visiting.
